args.prompt:
Create ONE new KFB Slop asset sheet: exactly SIX unique absurd-surreal emotionally expressive INK BLOB MONSTERS, landscape3columns x2rows, transparent PNG target1536x1024. Theme: SIMPLE APARTMENT RESIDENTS performing absurd neighborhood rituals. Tender dry satire of everyday coexistence, each independently readable alone. Small humble clothing accents, one simple household prop each, ink face/body dominant. No scenelets, lettering, labels, floor or cast-shadow discs.
INPUT ROLES: Image1 ORIGINAL style reference for rich tactile modeling, rounded thick goo body and eyelids; Image2 ORIGINAL family morphology, not its repeated grins. Neither an edit target. New characters, not veterans/pirates/reference costume copies. No generated image as style parent.
ACCEPTED MATERIAL STEERING, keep gentle: Preserve the rounded soft modeled stop-motion plasticine/claymation ink language, tactile fine fingerprints, organic asymmetry and dimensional handworked forms. Nudge body color only slightly toward deeper charcoal-black ink than the references: deep plum stays a subtle undertone. Keep soft satin reflections and rounded lit volumes, not flat black, wet chrome, shiny vinyl, fuzzy felt or fabric weave on the goo. Cloth accessories may retain cloth texture. Soft upper-left light, restrained contour highlights; no bright white/lavender rim glow. Gentle continuity adjustment only, not a new style or liquid material. Offbeat grotesque charming practical clay puppets, avoid generic polished family-animation/Pixar faces.
ANATOMY/EYES: One complete UPRIGHT FOOTLESS continuous ink blob each, soft thick asymmetrical splat lobes and short ink hands. No human torso/legs/feet, fur, severed bust or full human outfit. WHITE/IVORY sclera surrounds RED iris and BLACK pupil in each visible eye. Thick fully filled dark modeled lids. No red eyeballs/glow. Teeth emerge from INSIDE mouth/upper gum, not outside lower lip. Closed mouths toothless. Exactly TWO female-read figures, cells2and4, conveyed subtly by styling, not human anatomy.
LAYOUT: Precisely3columns2rows, reading order left-right top-bottom. Six equally prominent LARGE catalogue figures, similar perceived body mass and scale across rows. Each total silhouette including droplets/props fills about84% of its equal cell height, with generous safe transparent margins on ALL sides (at least24px) and clear non-touching gutters. Entire upright character visible, no shared props, inter-character gestures, overlap or cropped extremities. No chair,door,seat or environmental context. Retain tactile craft at native resolution, readable acting at96px. Face silhouette, gaze, mouth and posture all unique; not six angry grins or six hat swaps.

1. PLATZ FREIHALTEN — Broad squat squarish-rounded male-read resident, three short uneven goo crests. Small rusty orange neckerchief only. Stubborn narrow white eyes with iris/pupil visible, one tense lid and huge protruding CLOSED toothless indignant pout. Holds a single folded faded striped hand towel close to chest like a territorial flag, wooden clothespin clipped to towel. Other ink hand firmly palm-out at belly height. Full upright blob, no chair or actual saved seat.

2. HILFE UNGERN ANNEHMEN — Female-read tall asymmetric pear-shaped blob, modest lashes and lopsided ink quiff wrapped in a thin faded lavender headband. A tiny crooked FOLDED umbrella with one bent handle is held tightly to herself. Chin lifted, one eye widens with apprehension and other squints with proud denial, small strained TWO UPPER TOOTH grimace inside mouth. One ink hand briefly reaches outward then curls back against body. No helper or shared object.

3. UNGEFRAGT ERKLÄREN — Lean male-read wavy upright ink blob, single off-center folded crest, tiny faded green collar. One animated ink hand raises one rounded teaching finger near his shoulder, other holds one compact rolled cloth measuring tape with a short dangling end, NO NUMERALS. Earnestly bulging white eyes looking directly at camera, tilted lecturing brow and small sideways open mouth with THREE uneven upper teeth, intense excitement about a minor household fact. No blackboard or complex machine.

4. LEISE WIDERSPRECHEN — Female-read round scalloped wide blob with one soft sideways crest, subtle lashes, a small muted teal neck bow. Holds one simple small wooden door wedge close at flank; other ink hand makes a tiny low palm-up gesture. One eyelid heavy with weary doubt, the other lifted with unexpected resolve; tight lopsided CLOSED mouth, no teeth, no lipstick. Gaze direct and quietly firm, body leaning forward slightly, upright and full-sized. No door or building scene.

5. EINE AUSNAHME WIDERWILLIG GEWÄHREN — Tall bell-shaped male-read ink blob with drooping double crest, a small beige pajama collar. One ink hand pinches one small BLANK cream ticket at his own chest, other hand reluctantly opens with palm up. Hooded eyes still show white sclera, one raised brow betrays warm concern, a long crooked CLOSED compressed smile almost admitting affection. Not angry V-brows or round O mouth; no glasses, rulebook, cap or stamps.

6. GELIEHENES ÜBERFEIERLICH ZURÜCKGEBEN — Short broad triangle-lobed male-read ink blob, swept-back asymmetric two-prong goo crest, tiny burgundy fabric collar accent. Both ink hands proudly display ONE old wooden spoon tied with a very small burgundy ribbon, held securely against his own body without handing it to anyone. Huge delighted white eyes, eager lifted brows, small skewed open FOUR TOOTH smile in mouth. Ceremonial triumph wildly out of proportion to the mundane spoon. No tongue gag, no medal, no full suit.
Freeze each at strongest comic emotional beat; ordinary situations magnified by monster acting, not conceptual contraptions. Avoid repeating the last sheet's scarf+mitten, soup bowl, teacups, key, blank book, spectacles or stock faces. Transparent empty background, no matte/halo.
